title: The model's answer for one batch of reviewed values of one feature (BR-N06; ADR-034). Fixed keys, so strict structured output works for any output fields.

id.description: The id of the value, as given.

case.description: The case of the rule that was applied, by its name in the rule; 'Anything else' when none fits.

display.description: The normalized value in one line, for people.

flag.description: True when the expert should look at it (a conversion, a guess, no case fits).

note.description: What was done, and why, in one or two sentences.
